"''Closed for the night. Thank you!|Din Djarin and the Ardennian|}} An '''Ardennian fry cook''' ran a food stall named [[Hugo's]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. One [[Local day|night]], the [[Frycook|fry cook]] was preparing a grilled flat meat fry at the stall when the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] approached along with his{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 6: The Prisoner}} adoptive son [[Din Grogu]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 24: The Return}} and placed a single silver triangular [[Galactic Credit Standard|New Republic Credit]] atop the counter, requesting information. Eager for the valuable credit, the fry cook put down his [[Foodstuff|food]] and offered to speak freely. When the Mandalorian added that he was searching for a [[Hutt]], the fry cook nervously and cheerily announced that the stall was closing for the night and promptly shuttered the stall. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Voiced by the American filmmaker [[Martin Scorsese]],{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-trailer-key-art-2|text=Pedro Pascal Stars in New Trailer for ''The Mandalorian and Grogu''}} the Ardennian fry cook first appeared in the [[2026]] film ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu|The Mandalorian and Grogu]]''{{'s}} trailer, released on [[February 17]], [[2026]]. The character was identified as an "Ardennian fry cook" in a [[StarWars.com]] article and as a "Fry Cook" in an image released by [[The Walt Disney Company|The Walt Disney Studios]] on [[Wikipedia:Getty Images|Getty Images]] that day.{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/shxcb9rqpkwjq438nx4h9vx|text=THND-FF-000438|date=2026-02-17}} The character's stall features two [[Aurebesh]] signs that read "HUGO'S"—[[Wikipedia:Hugo (film)|''Hugo'']] is a [[2011]] film directed by Scorsese. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu]]'' ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|IHWlvwu8t1w|The Mandalorian and Grogu | Official Trailer | In Theaters May 22}} *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-trailer-key-art-2|text=Pedro Pascal Stars in New Trailer for ''The Mandalorian and Grogu''}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Ardennians]] [[Category:Chefs]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
